about.title: About us
about.text: JS Moto is a motorcycle shop and workshop in Chernivtsi. We restore, repair and diagnose motorcycles, from routine maintenance to a full rebuild.

master.title: Master Serhii
master.subtitle: Owner and head mechanic
master.text: Serhii has worked with motorcycles for many years. He grew from an enthusiast into a qualified master who takes on everything from quick diagnostics to complex restorations. He treats every bike as his own: honestly, carefully and all the way to the result. His love of motorcycles is the main reason customers keep coming back.
